title: 巴克莱印度CEO：重启权益承销，为何说是长期结构性机会？
speaker: Pramod Kumar

segments.en: Are you re-entering into the ECM market? Yes, we are planning to.
segments.zh: 你们要重新进入权益承销市场吗？是的，我们正计划这么做。

segments.en: We've got a very strong investment banking offering across financing, M&A, corporate banking. I think this is the only piece.
segments.zh: 我们在融资、并购、公司银行等投行业务上实力很强，只差这一块。

segments.en: So we are thinking seriously about it as we see it as a long-term structural opportunity and we do want to serve our clients with sort of full suite of products. Actively considering that.
segments.zh: 我们认真考虑此事，视其为长期结构性机会，希望以全产品线服务客户，正在积极评估。

segments.en: What sort of timeline can you give us there? Let's see. What do you have to wait for still? Is there anything that's still? No, no. No, we don't have to, you know, of course, getting something off the ground from ground zero takes time. So yeah, we're at that stage, yeah.
segments.zh: 能给出时间表吗？再看看。还在等什么？没有。从零起步当然需要时间，我们正处于这个阶段。
